{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Get array with all items (of any kind, even weapons) from uniform.

|s1= [[uniformItems]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[String]]s - Class names of items

|x1= <sqf>
uniformItems player;
// returns e.g
/*
[
	"FirstAidKit",
	"30Rnd_65x39_caseless_mag",
	"30Rnd_65x39_caseless_mag",
	"30Rnd_65x39_caseless_mag"
]
*/
</sqf>

|seealso= [[vestItems]] [[backpackItems]]
}}
